title: Esangweni taxi rank, Tembisa (approx.): taxi driver shot dead and two wounded by gunmen; no arrests, 27 Oct

story: A taxi driver was shot dead and two other people were wounded at the Esangweni taxi rank in Tembisa at about 05:00 on Tuesday 27 October, according to police. Police say five unknown men approached the victim, two of them armed with 9mm firearms, and opened fire; the two wounded were taken to hospital and the men fled on foot. The motive is unknown and no arrests had been made. No one is named. Tembisa South police station. One source, the SAPS Gauteng statement of 27 October; the only news coverage found was in Caxton papers, which are not used. The map point is approximate: the mapped Esangweni taxi rank, not a confirmed spot.
incident: Tue 27 Oct 2026, at about 05:00, when Tembisa South SAPS received the complaint (police)
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Esangweni Taxi Rank, Tembisa (police). The pin is the taxi rank mapped in OpenStreetMap as 'Thembisa Taxi Rank - ER019, Esangweni' (Mississipi Street area, Sangweni section), taken to be the rank police name; Esangweni may have more than one rank, so it is not a confirmed spot. Tembisa South police precinct.
